label: managerial or organizational leader of
definition: Person X holds a managerial or organizational leadership office in organization or political body Y.
scope_notes: Chairman, head, executive and leader paths dominate, preserving the prior broad leadership scope. Founder, ownership and ordinary membership alone are separate relations. Party adjectives and party-labelled unnamed persons remain identity ambiguities.

facts.reason: Chairman and head paths would support a leadership office, but Republican identifies an unnamed party-labelled individual and membership rows may concern different people.
facts.reviewer_question: Which individual does Republican identify, and do the chairmanship and ordinary membership rows refer to that same person?

facts.reason: John Sculley is explicitly Apple chairman, executive and head; resignation paths establish historical office.
Felix G. Rohatyn is explicitly chairman and head of the Municipal Assistance Corporation.
L. Dennis Kozlowski is explicitly executive of Tyco International and resigns as chairman and executive; accusation is additional mixed evidence.
Nancy Pelosi is described with Democratic chairman and member paths, but Democratic omits the particular organization or committee she chairs.
facts.reviewer_question: What body is omitted after Democratic, and is Pelosi its chair rather than simply a Democratic member or activist?
